prose: Axios reports Circuit Mind, which applies AI to automating electronics and circuit design, has raised $25 million - including an $18.5 million Series A led by Norwest - and plans to relocate to the US. CEO Tomide Adesanmi disclosed the round to Axios Pro.
highlights: Circuit Mind raises $25M, including an $18.5M Series A led by Norwest
AI software for electronics and circuit design
CEO Tomide Adesanmi spoke to Axios Pro
